oneLine: A-One Steels India plans an IPO to raise ₹405 crore.

sources.title: Bengaluru-based A-One Steels India to raise ₹405 crore in an IPO

synopsis: Bengaluru-headquartered integrated steel manufacturer A-One Steels India Limited is launching an initial public offering to raise ₹405 crore. The subscription period opens on September 24, 2026, with shares scheduled to debut on the BSE and NSE on October 1, 2026. The price band has been fixed at ₹385 to ₹405 per share. The issue comprises both a fresh issue of shares and an offer for sale, with proceeds primarily earmarked for the repayment of outstanding borrowings, including ₹250 crore allocated exclusively from the ₹355 crore fresh issue proceeds toward debt repayment. Promoters of the company include Sandeep Kumar, Sunil Jalan, and Krishan Kumar Jalan.
